body.name: Observable-moment-compressed rational-grid inner body and outer inflation
body.construction: For each finite-stratum response set \(F_\kappa\), form \(\mathcal G_{\kappa,L}\), set \(\mathcal C_{\kappa,L}=\operatorname{conv}v(\mathcal G_{\kappa,L})\), and inflate it by the observable-moment-compressed cube \([-e_{F_\kappa,L},e_{F_\kappa,L}]^m\).  Separately, form \(\mathcal G_{\infty,L}\) from \(F_\infty\), set \(\mathcal C_{\infty,L}=\operatorname{conv}v(\mathcal G_{\infty,L})\), and inflate it by \([-e_{F_\infty,L},e_{F_\infty,L}]^m\), where \(e_{H,L}=0\) for \(|H|=1\) and otherwise \(e_{H,L}=\min\{1,2(\min\{|H|,m\}-1)/L\}\).
